retrievalProfile.description: A three-column vertical layout featuring a central text block flanked by solid color bars and a bottom-aligned photographic portrait.

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured graphic composition divided into three vertical zones: a central cream-colored column containing a large display name, a script title, and a tracklist, flanked by a blue left bar and a green right bar, with a rectangular photographic portrait anchored at the bottom center.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical tri-panel division of the canvas
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy balanced by a bottom-heavy image
Central alignment of all text elements within the middle column
Muted, desaturated color palette against a cream background
coreInvariants: Rounded corner border framing the entire composition
Vertical color bars on the left and right margins
Contrast between heavy condensed sans-serif and fluid script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typographic header dominates the top third; photographic portrait occupies the bottom third of the central column.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold, olive-green artist name at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow from the artist name, through the script title and tracklist, ending at the portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous cream-colored margins around the central text block to ensure legibility.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background for the central column.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted sky blue and lime green for the flanking vertical bars.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Olive green for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, mid-to-high value colors typical of 1960s print media.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses high-waisted, condensed, blocky letterforms
Secondary title uses a connected, slanted formal script with moderate stroke contrast
Body text uses a clean, all-caps sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed sans-serif paired with a fluid, elegant script for stylistic contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy condensed display feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cream-colored square canvas with a thin rounded-corner border. Add a vertical blue bar on the left and a vertical green bar on the right. Place a rectangular black and white portrait at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a bold condensed olive-green sans-serif at the top. Below it, add the title in a blue-grey script. Center a list of text lines in a small all-caps sans-serif between the title and the portrait.

verificationChecks: Is the layout divided into three vertical zones?
Is the artist name the largest typographic element?
Is the portrait anchored to the bottom of the central column?
Are the colors muted and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Width of the side color bars
postGenerationChecks: Check for rounded corners on the outer frame
Ensure the script font is legible and connected
Verify the tracklist is perfectly centered
Confirm the side bars are solid, flat colors
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Tri-Panel Layout + Condensed Sans/Script Pairing + Bottom-Anchored Portrait
